review_evidence: scribe-theory.lisp and latex-theory.lisp define printer functions and syntax-extension machinery; scribe-init.lisp and latex-init.lisp define formatting, margin, tabbing, index, and special-character functions.

sloop.lisp defines SLOOP and related loop macros plus the parser/expansion implementation; infix.lisp and acl2-formatting.lisp are part of the same executable infix interface rather than declaration-free setup files.
No source-local class in this unit satisfies the lossless hard-exclusion invariant.
summary: Reviewed the interface/infix unit. All seven files are substantive parser/pretty-printer and loop/interface implementation sources and remain searchable.
